messages:
Priya (Design): Quick pickup on Autoscale controls — new compact mock uploaded. Main goals: 1) make SLO slider modes obvious (Off / Preset / Custom), 2) improve discoverability for Burst when pool rows are tight, 3) ensure keyboard order pool picker -> burst -> slo is linear. Thoughts? Noah (Frontend): Ok. Two constraints: moving Burst out of the card helps visibility but uses more vertical space; keyboard order follows DOM. I can prototype a compact floating Burst pill anchored to the right of the row. Ava (A11Y): Love the keyboard-first approach. A11y notes: burst pill contrast ~3.8:1, needs 4.5:1. SLO slider should expose aria-valuetext like "SLO 200ms (preset)" and preset buttons need aria-pressed. Visible focus ring required. Sam (PM): Defaults must be cost-safe. Set conservative default min/max and add a guardrail hint when burst >50%: small inline text explaining cost/latency tradeoff. Also prefer soft nudge if SLO > pool capacity (no auto-upgrade). Jae (Eng): Implementation: burst maps to burst_quota on the API. Floating UI ok but must bind to selected pool id. Suggest backend expose presets as named profiles (preset_id) to avoid churn. Also cap burst_quota at pool_max with a clear warning. Priya (Design): Microcopy: change label to "Burst capacity" and tooltip: "Temporary extra GPUs for spikes — billed while active." For SLO states: Off = ghosted thumb + "Disabled"; Preset = chip name; Custom = numeric readout. I'll adjust contrast and order in the spec. Noah (Frontend): For aria I'll add role="slider" aria-valuemin/aria-valuemax/aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext. Example:
Ava (A11Y): Good. Ensure Tab lands on burst toggle in one press from pool picker. Avoid visual-only reordering where DOM doesn't match focus order. Sam (PM): Copy for capacity nudge: option A: "This SLO may need more capacity — view options." Option B: "SLO exceeds pool capacity — explore upgrade." I vote A (less alarming). Priya (Design): A it is. I'll push updated frames and add an a11y checklist. Noah (Frontend): I'll build a quick prototype tomorrow, behind feature flag, and wire cost-estimator to show estimated monthly delta when SLO changes. deploy-bot: deploy/ui-staging v2.18.0 succeeded — https://staging.redwood.dev/deploys/4315 Priya (Design): Thanks — ping me when staging is up, I'll run a 10min usability pass and verify keyboard flow. :rocket:
